item.title: Geoengineering is destroying insect and invertebrate populations
item.description: America Out Loud PULSE with Dr. Clayton J. From firsthand observations and conservation experience, she warns of cascading environmental consequences and urges immediate action to protect biodiversity, food systems, and planetary health for future generations worldwide...
